name: Bydlo v Sovyonke
source:
An unusual guy named Semyon was running from an unknown person, but Semyon is no coward, so eventually he got tired of running and decided to fight back. It turned out that this unknown entity was not just an unusual person, but some sort of correctional mechanism. It sent Semyon to Sovyonok to correct him, but something went wrong in Sovyonok...

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1706572704]Steam[/url]]
